watch.summary: The streamer reacts with intense hype and excitement as his favorite esports team wins a critical Valorant match round.

beats.what: The streamer watches an intense Valorant round unfold while shouting encouragement.
The team clinches the round win and the streamer leaps out of his seat shouting in celebration.
He points to his temples repeatedly, boasting about the team's attack strategy.
He pulls out a team jersey while laughingly repeating 'job's not done'.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: That was our attack round, baby!
watch.why: This clip relies on high energy esports reaction rather than structured comedy or comedic timing. Viewers without knowledge of the match context will find it mostly hype rather than funny.
